policy_content.description: All registered backends must report PASS for workload to be HEALTHY

rules.description: Workload transitions to HEALTHY only when every configured backend returns PASS
Any backend FAIL triggers state transition to FAILED and KBS secret revocation

policy_content.description: Container images must have a valid cosign signature before workload enrollment

rules.description: Image has a valid cosign signature matching the configured public key
Reject workload registration when image has no cosign signature

policy_content.description: Workloads that go stale beyond threshold are automatically revoked

rules.description: Workload revoked if no attestation received within 10 minutes
Alert fired when workload has not re-attested in 5 minutes
